claims.title: Receiver-free rough contact: continuous wrench allocation and required local qualification

quoted_fields.interface: Twelve groups at R32mm, exact opposed preload, Fn>=0 and Fn/100N+|Ft|/250N+|Mxy|/10Nm<=1, plus independent signed10N normal/10N shear/.25Nm bending self envelopes. At each declared point-force port,0<=inward s<=150N,|t|<=.5s,n<=.7s,n>=-100N are REQUIRED introduced laws, not asperity measurements. Known opposite-pair removal, normal allocation A^T(AA^T)^-1 and equal net shear with balanced geometry. Unknown contact moments, material/capacity/error/state/hold dynamics remain physical construction requirements.
quoted_fields.failure: Continuous scope comes from support functions of explicit convex sets, not a finite-angle reliability or dynamic threshold. Exact pair symmetry, known disabled pair and the local cone are assumptions, not observations. Thirty installed tips are not thirty engaged tips; gamma and8N capacity must be qualified. Tile-only geometry supplies no complete support, sensor, latch, ring, tendon or route. A finite contact patch is not an actual moment-free point-force port. No full rough-surface100N/250N/10Nm device, autonomy, life, service advantage, novelty or all-design obstruction.
